title: Visitors Centre, Yad Vashem
visualBrief: The square Visitors Centre retains its six-bay pale concrete frame, deep colonnades, recessed glazing, offset car-park entry, gridded roof and south terrace. The fitted deck exposes all four arcades and keeps the parking approach connected.

The Commons category locates the Visitors Centre at31.774258,35.176556, about6m from the mapped roof centroid; its two ordinary exterior photographs and the annotated campus aerial identify this particular building. Internal+X points east-northeast toward the car park; internal+Z south-southeast toward the long colonnade. The east car-park photo fixes the fascia notch and entry on the+X face, offset toward+Z. Heading0 with these signed axes baked into model east/south coordinates. No invented member Wikidata identity; all other campus members remain independent.
